_readme: Fill in pages and selectors/mapping for each source. Use `python -m adoptme probe <url>` to inspect a page. Sources with no pages/selectors are skipped. amvgg.com is intentionally NOT listed: its terms prohibit scraping without written permission.

elvebredd._note: Add the value-list page URL(s) under pages, e.g. {"url": "...", "category": "pets"}. If the site renders from JSON, change type to "json" and use a `mapping` block instead (see README).

adoptmevalues._note: /values is the value list page. Selectors still need filling in from the live HTML (run `probe`). If the page is JS-rendered, use type "json" with embedded_selector or the XHR endpoint.
